empty: No accounts yet: everything starts from the first one.

wealth.label: Net worth
wealth.missingContributions: {amount} of undeclared contributions: check the account’s cash balance
wealth.holdingsIncluded: including {amount} of investments, at the latest price

newAccount.title: New account
newAccount.description: An account that already existed starts from its opening balance, which is not income.

edit.description: Its balance starts from the opening, then follows its movements.

close.title: Close “{name}”?
close.description: No more movements after that day. Its history stays whole, and you can reopen it.

reopen.title: Reopen “{name}”?
reopen.description: The account accepts movements again. Its history does not change.

check.title: Check {name}
check.description: The balance your bank shows, against today’s computed one: {amount}.

history.title: Balance checks of {name}
history.description: The balance read, against the one computed that day.
history.never: This account has never been checked.
history.correctDescription: Editing a balance check means doing it again: the gap is recomputed on the history as it stands today.
history.correctSettled: The adjustment that settled it follows the new gap, and disappears if nothing is left to settle.
history.deleteSettled: The adjustment that settled its gap is deleted with it: it existed only for this balance check.
history.deleteUnsettled: The account’s movements are not touched: a balance check only sets them against reality.

settle.title: Settle the gap
settle.explain: A single movement dated that day carries them, attributed to the chosen counterparty: a last resort, declaring what is missing is better.
settle.ghost: ghost: this gap says nothing about my flows (a correction) and must stay out of every analysis

rail.ariaGap: {name}: checked on {date}, gap of {amount} not settled
rail.count: {count, plural, one {# balance check} other {# balance checks}} in {days} days

card.day: on the {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}

cardPage.nothingPaid: Nothing has been paid with this card yet.
cardPage.moveToNewCard: to move to the new card

cardForm.ifWeekend: If it falls on a weekend
cardForm.newDescription: A name is enough to recognize it, never its number.
cardForm.editDescription: A new schedule moves the purchases of statements not yet validated. Those of a validated statement stay on its debit day.
cardForm.deleteDescription: Only a card that paid nothing can be deleted. A card that was used stays: its expiry says it no longer works.

statement.title: Statement of {name}
statement.description: {count, plural, one {# purchase cut off} other {# purchases cut off}} on {date}, for <money>{amount}</money>. They move to the debit day and enter the balance.
